summary: John's 2nd great-grandmother; English-born, immigrated c.1870–72 with Welsh-born father Edward F. Jones.
bio:
Anna C. Jones was born Mar 1865 in England and immigrated about 1870–72 (FS GZQT-T86). Her parents were Edward F. Jones (b. c.1840 Wales) and Margaret McIver (b. c.1845 England), in Plymouth in 1880. She married James McGuire and was mother of 11+ children including Francis J. (1898). Her brother Joseph S. Jones married Agnes M. McAvoy, sister of her daughter-in-law Elizabeth. She died 2 Jan 1925 in Larksville.

The 1925 state death index lists "McGuire, Anna C.; 7765; Larksville; Jan. 2" ([R4-S1]). In the 1880 census at Plymouth Township, Ann C. Jones, 15, born in England, lived with her Welsh-born father Edward F. Jones (miner) and English-born mother Margaret; her sisters Rose (13) and Mary (10, a servant) were also born in England, and her brother William J. was born in Pennsylvania in September 1879 ([R4-S2]). The family therefore came over between about 1870 and 1879. Her son William's 1927 licence again gives her birthplace as England ([R4-S3]).
